title: Patriots, QB DeVito agree to 2-year, $7.4M deal

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Patriots, QB DeVito agree to 2-year, $7.4M deal
sources.description: The Patriots and restricted free agent quarterback Tommy DeVito have agreed to a two-year deal with a maximum value of $7.4 million, DeVito's agent told ESPN's Adam Schefter.
